authority.actor: Ricardo (repository owner), via explicit continuation request and original consolidation brief
authority.scope: CVG-004 bounded tenant-scoped scheduled registration-services report source through the real worker
authority.decision: Authorize reversible services-module and worker implementation plus focused and disposable PostgreSQL/process verification of the existing read-only registration-services schedule. The source may expose only the six cataloged persisted service fields code, name, description, basePrice, status and createdAt; it must derive tenant scope from the claimed schedule, apply strict UTC createdAt date filters and a 10,000-row bound, fail closed on missing/foreign/malformed source rows and retain the existing durable schedule audit and one-shot failure semantics. Exclude on-demand API redesign, service CRUD, supplier/owner/patient/administrative report expansion, migrations, providers, credentials, target, production, deployment, external mutation, backfill and release acceptance.
authority.expires_or_revalidates: Revalidate before changing services lifecycle/CRUD, adding search/status filters, exposing new data, adding another registry report, provider delivery, target operations or production behavior.

next_action: Write and run the intentional services-source and worker RED tests, then implement the smallest bounded tenant-aware source and real run-once proof.
revalidation_triggers: Changes to the services schema, status/price semantics or tenant RLS policy
Changes to worker bootstrap, schedule claiming, report execution/export/audit or one-shot failure behavior
